name: AXM Choice-First Visual & Simulation Lab
summary: Choose exact 2D and pixel-styled 3D asset profiles, compose Style Fabric, AetherFX, PBR and supplied Storycraft treatments into live animated GLBs, inspect declared cross-surface losses, test whole-game pack continuity, exercise causal state and sofa upgrades, and review the pilot film.
notes: All artifacts remain candidate-only. Four animated 3D pilot assets and four treated variants do not constitute a complete whole-game 3D pack. Web-only and token-only effects are never claimed as GLB shader parity. Recommendations never activate a pack. This lab cannot detect hardware, install, promote, canonize, or silently substitute a representation or treatment.
